newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Sara Lee buys Australia's Nutri-Metics.
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee buys Australia's Nutri-Metics.

text.p: United States-based consumer products and food group Sara Lee Corp said on Monday that it had acquired unlisted Australian skin care and beauty products group Nutri-Metics International for an undisclosed sum.
Sara Lee said in a statement issued from its Chicago head office that Nutri-Metics had annual sales of about US$200 million.
Nutri-Metics sells its products through a network of independent representatives in 18 countries including Australia, France, Greece, Malaysia and Thailand.
Nutri-Metics would continue to operate under its current name, with chairwoman Imelda Roche and managing director David Hall, to remain actively involved.
"The acquisition of Nutri-Metrics significantly expands Sara Lee Corp's direct seling operations, particularly in the important Pacific Rim market," Sara Lee Corp president C. Steven McMillan said.
"Nutri-Metics provides a successful business with growth potential in its existing operations, which we can also selectively expand into new markets," McMillan said.
